page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.vgn6i-m4-vws.xlarge is a GPU-accelerated virtual server instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 4 dedicated vCPUs from an Intel Xeon 8163 processor running at 2.5 GHz, paired with 23.0 GB of system memory. The instance includes a fractional NVIDIA T4 GPU allocation representing 0.25 of a physical GPU with 4 GB of dedicated VRAM. It does not include local storage, relying entirely on network-attached storage, and provides a baseline network bandwidth of 2 Gbps.

Performance benchmarks place this instance in the lower tiers for raw compute and memory throughput. The Intel Xeon 8163 CPU scores in the bottom 25% for both single-core and multi-core stress-ng tests, as well as Passmark CPU evaluations. Memory performance is also constrained, with large-block read bandwidth categorized in the bottom 10% and write bandwidth in the bottom 25%. Similarly, Geekbench single-core and multi-core scores fall in the bottom 10%, reflecting limited processing speeds for tasks like image and text processing.

Given the fractional GPU and modest CPU performance, the ecs.vgn6i-m4-vws.xlarge is designed for entry-level GPU workloads rather than heavy parallel computing. The 4 GB VRAM allocation is suitable for lightweight 3D rendering, basic model inference, or virtual desktop infrastructure applications. However, the lack of local storage and lower network bandwidth baseline of 2 Gbps present tradeoffs for data-intensive applications. This instance is qualitatively cost-efficient for development environments and low-demand GPU tasks that do not require a full dedicated accelerator.
